title: Zakkai the Butcher
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:1 he reports Rabbi Yochanan: after the Megillah one blesses, “Who pleads your cause,” etc. Hyman reports that Pesikta Rabbati, at the beginning of Mi-ni Efrayim, 56b, attributes the statement to Rabbi Zecharyah the Butcher; he says the name should read Zakkai the Butcher.

notes.text: ריבך means “your cause,” not “our cause.” The quotation follows Hyman’s supplied wording rather than silently replacing it with a different benediction text.
